nodes.label: Contract & NPN Enrollment Allocation Rules
nodes.rationale: Routes enrollments to the correct Writing NPN based on contract structure (TBI/AP use Agent NPN; AQP #20011862, ALP #19876750, PT #18819956; Hoa Dao #20664479 for FL Blue/FL Health Plans; Nhi Tran #20461483 for SC BCBS) to prevent $0 commission losses.

nodes.label: 18 Special States State-Based Marketplaces (SBM)
nodes.rationale: Agents cannot earn NPN credit via HealthSherpa/Healthcare.gov in these 18 SBM states and must enroll directly on state portals after state certification; GA and CA provide consumer search by SSN without forcing client password resets.

nodes.label: Zero-Commission & Carrier Member Cap Traps
nodes.rationale: Prevents enrolling clients into non-commission carriers or capped policies (Molina $0 new member in FL/IL/MI/SC/TX; Oscar 5-member cap; Anthem state caps; Ambetter NM, Select Health CO/ID, Kaiser HI, Anthem NY, BCBS AR 2026).

nodes.label: 1099 Policy & SSN Eligibility Rules
nodes.rationale: Presidio (TX) and USA HealthPlan require a valid SSN; clients without SSN are routed to Uhone Health Protector Guard or GWSW Virtual Health.

nodes.label: HubSpot CRM Ownership & SSS Standards
nodes.rationale: Contact, Deal, Ticket, and Upload Document owners must match the Agent account to prevent deals defaulting to the company and stripping Agent production credit; Agent deals only use PARTIAL (0.5) or NONE (0.7), while company deals use FULL (0).

nodes.label: UHC Cancel-Back & ALP (#19876750) Transfer Protocol
nodes.rationale: AQP lacks an active UHC contract, so UHC cases without Agent AP contract are switched to another carrier or re-enrolled under ALP (#19876750) after obtaining a fresh Consent Form.

nodes.label: Payment Ticket, QT10 & Quarterly $0 Audit Rules
nodes.rationale: Enforces QT10 autopay checks from the 15th, 1099 payment tickets, urgent Payment Issue Ticket handling via NIC reports, quarterly $0 plan audits (months 2/5/8/11), and peer cross-checking to stop premature ticket closure.

nodes.label: Support Non-Advising & Telesales Routing Rule
nodes.rationale: Support staff lack insurance licenses and must never advise clients 1-on-1; Agents unable to advise are routed to Telesales with a 50% commission split instead of 70%.

nodes.label: CEO Auto-Renew Active Dual-Verification Rule
nodes.rationale: Only Managers may move Medicare deals to Auto Renew Active, and only after verifying both plan suitability and client contact plus carrier portal visibility.

nodes.label: ACA Ready To Enroll (RTE 2027) 3-Case SOP
nodes.rationale: Standardizes 3 client intake paths, State Override exclusions (IA, WI, AK, MI, FL, NC, WV, SD, DE, NH), mandatory 2027 checkbox on HealthSherpa authorization, and $150 non-commission fee options.

nodes.label: 9 Standard Consent Form & SOA Templates (CRM Library)
Work Permit (EAD) December Enrollment Rule
nodes.rationale: Deferring Work Permit enrollments to December (instead of November) with Permanent Resident selection secures full 2027 APTC and guarantees 3 active months (Jan-Mar 2027) before potential DMI termination so carrier bonuses are not clawed back.

nodes.label: Undocumented / DMI Multi-Option Advisory Matrix
nodes.rationale: Prohibits dead-end refusals ('cannot apply') by requiring Support/Managers to offer 3-4 pathways: I-94/I-797/Visa verification, ACA No-Sub self-pay, 3-month temporary Sub, or Uhone/GWSW private alternatives.
